headlineReason: Cross-sectional excess is the standard market-factor abnormal return and is computable from exactly the two snapshots a horizon needs, so the headline is never absent for a window that is otherwise measurable. `rawReturnPct` and `sectorExcessPct` (vs the sector's own trailing drift over the same length) are published alongside for every sample, but the trailing baseline needs a full prior window of tape and is therefore null through the early history.

method.entryRule: earliest tape snapshot whose market clock (asOf) is at or after the story's firstSeenAt
method.exitRule: earliest tape snapshot whose market clock is at or after firstSeenAt + horizon; pending when none exists
method.minWindow: a window shorter than minWindowFraction x horizon is pending, never an ok sample: with one snapshot entry and exit are the same instant and the return would be 0% by construction
method.rawReturnPct: ratio of chained board levels between entry and exit
method.sectorExcessPct: rawReturnPct minus the same board's return over an equally long window ending at entry (trailing drift); null until that prior window exists
method.marketExcessPct: rawReturnPct minus the cross-sectional mean of all industry boards over the identical entry→exit window
method.marketUniverse: industry boards only (concepts would double-count the measured sectors); a board counts only when quoted at both endpoints within one chain segment
method.changePct: tape changePct is relative to the previous close, so returns are computed from chained day-over-day levels, never from a difference of two changePct values
method.levels: level(t) = base(day) x (1 + changePct/100), base chained from each day's close; a missing close starts a new segment and a window spanning it is a gap, never interpolated
method.attribution: entity -> theme table (reviewable, in lib/reactions/attribution.ts) first, then topic, then 上证指数 as a market fallback; nothing is inferred
method.attributionStates: entity = a sector board resolved and the tape quoted it; topic = the topic's broad board resolved; market = the tape HAS started, the index is quoted, and the story genuinely has no entity or topic link; pending = the tape has not started, so no board has ever been quoted and nothing can be attributed either way — 'we could not check yet', counted in attributed.pending, never rolled into market; null = the tape started but neither a sector board nor the index was quoted (attributed.unmapped)
method.aggregateUniverse: topic rows hold entity- and topic-attributed samples only; market-attributed stories are measured on the index and are reported in counts.attributed instead, never as a sector reaction
method.minimumSample: an aggregate is published only at n >= 20; below it the row carries n and status "insufficient" with no mean, median or percentiles
method.hitRate: share of marketExcessPct samples > 0, where a sign is declared for the key
method.reproducibility: no wall clock, no randomness; arrays are sorted by stable keys so a cold rebuild over identical inputs is byte-identical
